description.original: Audit GitHub Actions workflows for salient-path conditionals — every workflow that triggers on pull_request or push must filter on the files and directories its steps actually depend on, and skip with success when nothing salient changed. Use when adding a new workflow, modifying an existing one's steps, renaming/moving files a workflow depends on, or when a CI bill spike points at workflows running on irrelevant changes.
